title: NAPA Reauthorization Act
official_summary:
NAPA Reauthorization Act

This act extends through 2035 and makes other changes to the National Alzheimer's Project. This project supports coordination of federal planning, programs, and other efforts to address Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

In particular, the act incorporates a focus on promoting healthy aging and reducing risk factors associated with cognitive decline.

The act also expands the Advisory Council on Alzheimer's Research, Care, and Services to include additional members, such as (1) a researcher with experience recruiting and retaining diverse clinical trial participants, (2) an individual diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, and (3) representatives from additional federal agencies (e.g., the Department of Justice).

summary.headline: Extends the National Alzheimer's Project through 2035, adds a focus on healthy aging, and expands its advisory council.
summary.what_it_does: This law keeps the National Alzheimer's Project running through 2035. The project helps federal agencies coordinate their plans and programs on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. The law adds a focus on healthy aging and on reducing risk factors linked to memory and thinking decline. It also adds new members to the Advisory Council on Alzheimer's Research, Care, and Services.

who_it_affects.group: People living with Alzheimer's disease or other dementias
who_it_affects.how: The federal planning effort on these conditions continues through 2035, and a person diagnosed with Alzheimer's will now sit on the advisory council.

who_it_affects.group: Older adults and people concerned about memory decline
who_it_affects.how: The national plan will now include work on healthy aging and lowering risk factors for cognitive decline.
The advisory council will add a researcher with experience recruiting and keeping diverse participants in clinical trials.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies such as the Department of Justice
who_it_affects.how: Representatives from more federal agencies will join the advisory council.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 1, 2024; the project is extended through 2035.
